 (individually, or in the case of joint Lessors, collectively referred to as “ LESSOR ”, which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, Nominees, successors-in-interest, permitted transferees and permitted assigns) of the ONE PART . 
 
 AND 
 
 ZUI INVESTMENTS , a registered partnership firm under partnership act 1932 with Form C No.1442 dated 26.10.2018 with its registered office located at 94-B/1, Pearl One, MM Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore (“ LESSEE ” which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns) of the OTHER PART . 
 
 (Lessor and the Lessee shall hereinafter be referred to individually as a “ Party ” and collectively as the “ Parties ”) . 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 WHEREAS 
 
 The Lessee is a real estate developer, and has undertaken a real estate project named and styled as ‘Zameen Ace Mall’ comprising inter alia residential apartments, hotel apartments, and commercial shops, located at Plot No. 36-A, Sector J, Jinnah Avenue/Sir Syed Boulevard, Phase II, DHA Islamabad; 
 
 The Lessor is the sole, absolute and exclusive owner of a hotel apartment in ‘Zameen Ace Mall’ , purchased by the Lessor from the Lessee vide Agreement to Sell No. _______________ dated ________ executed by and between the Parties ; and 
 
 Pursuant to the terms and conditions of the aforementioned Agreement to Sell, the Lessor desires to lease back to the Lessee, and the Lessee desires to take on lease from the Lessor, the Demised Premises in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Lease back Agreement . 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE , Lessor and Lessee, intending to be legally bound, agree as follows: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 Th e Leaseback Agreement (defined below) , read with the Agreement to Sell along with all documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to sell, shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parti es hereto in respect of the lease back of the Demised Premises (defined below) . 
 
 The documents specified in Clause 1 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions , followed by Agreement to Sell , and d escription of Demised Premises . Any terms used as defined terms and not defined in the Leaseback Agreement shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Lease back Agreement. 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPREATION 
 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell specified in Recital (B) of the Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any U nit and are intended for the common use of all occupants of Units inter alia elevators, power backup equipment, security system, tube-well motors. 
 
 Common Facilities means all open areas, clubs, services, roads, pavements, water features, administrative office areas, installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security system, tube-well motors, improvements and common assets of the Common Areas that are intended for facilitating all occupants and owners of Units and do not form part of the Demised Premises. 
 
 Commencement Date means the date on which the Hotel Management Company launches the hotel for the Project, in accordance with the Permitted Use. 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority, which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or the Lease back Agreement. 
 
 Complimentary Voucher means a voucher for one night’s stay at the Demised Premises or a comparable hotel apartment/Unit in the Project free of cost, as being operated, managed and/or maintained by the Lessee or the Hotel Management Company, whereas Complimentary Vouchers means multiple. 
 
 Demised Premises means the Purchased U nit purchased through Agreement to Sell which the Lessee leases through this Lease back Agreement , as more fully described in Description of Purchased Unit/Demised Premises ap pended herewith. For the avoidance of doubt, Demised Premises means the Purchased Unit as mentioned under Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Due Date means the date on which any payment of R ent (defined below) is required to be paid by the Lessee to the Lessor in the designated bank account in accordance with the Leaseback Agreement . 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 31 an d 32 . 
 
 Leaseback Agreement means this Leaseback Agreement entered into between the Lessor and Lessee for the leaseback of the Demised Premises. 
 
 Hotel Management Company 
 means the entity or entities, which may include the Developer, any of its affiliates or associated companies or any other company (and their respective successors in interest and assigns) charged with the maintenance, operation or management of a luxury hotel, along with the Parking Area, Common Areas and/or Common Fa cilities. 
 
 Nominee has the meaning assigned to it in the Agreement to Sell . 
 
 Parking Area means the demarcated parking area for the exclusive use of any Lessee of the Project situa ted in the reserved parking lot. 
 
 Party means the Lessee or the Lessor, whereas Parties means both. 
 
 Permitted Use has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 10 of the Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 Project means the real estate residential apartment complex, named and styled as ‘Zameen Ace Mall”, being developed by the Developer. 
 
 Purchased Price shall have the meaning assigned to it in the Agreement to Sell . 
 
 Rent shall have the meaning assigned to it in Clause 7 of the Leaseback Agreement 
 
 Unit means a single hotel apartment in the Project , whereas Units means multiple. 
 
 Lease P eriod means a period of t en (10) years starting from the Commencement Date . 
 
 Expiry Date means the date corresponding to the last day of the Lease Period. 
 
 Except where the context otherwise requires, references in the Lease back Agreement to: 
 
 An Article, Clause, attachment, or paragraph are references to an Article, Clause, attachment or paragraph of the Leaseback Agreement or the relevant document comprising the Leaseback Agreement , unless otherwise specified ;

 No rule of construction shall apply to the disadvantage of a Party because that Party was responsible for the preparation of the Leaseback Agreement or any part there of;

 An obligation on a Party to do any act, matter or thing include an obligation to procure that it is done and words placing a Party under a restriction include an obligation not to permit or allow infringement of the restriction.

 Where there is a reference to “lease”, “leaseback” or other disposition of interest in any unit by the Lessor to the Lessee, such term refers to the disposition of interest of the Lessor’s rights relating to the Demised Premises, including the right to occupy and use such Unit and, where applicable, transfer those rights all upon and subject to the Leaseback Agreement ; 
 
 Any term not defined in the Leaseback Agreement shall have the meaning assigned to it in the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 TERM OF LEASE 
 
 The Lessor hereby agrees to irrevocably leaseback , and the Lessee hereby agrees to take on lease from the Lessor, the Demised Premises for the Lease Period, which shall commenc e on the Commencement Date. 
 
 The Lease Period may be renewed upon expiry thereof for further period of ten (10) years on the same terms and conditions of the Leasebac k Agreement in accordance with c lause 28 hereof . 
 
 RENT 
 
 In consideration of the lease of the Demised Premises, the Lessee shall pay Rent and other benefits to the Lessor during the Lease Period on the following terms: 
 
 Monthly Rent shall be paid on a pro-rated basis calculated at 7% of the Purchase Price of the Demised Premises per annum . 
 
 Rent shall be increased by 25% (twenty five percent) every three years of the Lease Period. 
 
 Rent shall be paid for eleven (11) months per year of the Lease Period , along with thirty (30) C omplimentary Vouchers . The Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed or encashed by the Lessor in accordance with Clause 8 of the Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 COMPLIMENTARY VOUCHERS 
 
 Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed or encashed by the Lessor as per the following terms : 
 
 A maximum of fifteen (15) Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed during peak season, and fifteen (15) during off-peak season , subject to availability . 
 
 Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed by the Lessor, either her/himself or for friends and family ( the “ Beneficiary ”), subject to availability. The Beneficiary shall have access to all Common F acilities and amenities of fered by the Hotel Management Company during their stay , as per the rules and regulations of the Hotel Management Company, and any additional services may be availed as per the standard schedule of rates &amp; charges set by the Hotel Management Company. 
 
 The Lessor may encash the Complimentary Vouchers in exchange for one month’s Rent. 
 
 Complimentary Vouchers shall be valid for a period of twelve (12) months from the date of issuance thereof and, if not redeemed or encashed during the stipulated period, shall not be carried forward for any further period. 
 
 OTHER CHARGES 
 
 All applicable taxes shall be borne and paid by the Parties in accordance with law. 
 
 
 PERMITTED USE 
 
 The Lessee will use , occupy , sub-lease the Demised Premises for the purpose of operating, managing and maintaining a l uxury h otel, either itself or through a Hotel Management Company, for the duration of the Lease Period. 
 
 The Lessee will comply with all applicable laws, ordinances, rules, orders, and regulations of any Competent Authority with respect to the Demised Premises and Permitted Use . 
 
 SALE AND ASSIGNMENT 
 
 The Lessor shall only transfer or assign the Demised Premises with written consent of the Lessee. Such sale/transfer shall only be done on the precondition that the Lessor shall cause the transferee of the Demised Premises to be bound by the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 The Lessee may sell, assign, transfer, sublease or otherwise dispose of its interests in the Demised Premises during the Lease Period as the Lessee deems fit for the Permitted Use, and the Lessor hereby undertakes to do or cause to be done any acts or execute any documents required in relation or ancillary thereto. Provided that any such disposition of interest shall be subject to the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement and the obligation for payment of Rent by the Lessee. 
 
 L ESSOR’S COVENANTS 
 
 The Lessor permits the Lessee to carry out any required internal partitions, modifications, or to dismantle or make alteration(s) to the Demised Premises , and install any billboards, hoardings, signage or any other promotional material as it deems fit for the Permitted Use . The Lessee shall also have the right to place and install on the Demised Premises specific outlets and adequate equipment, including inter alia equipment for central air-conditioning (if any). Lessee shall not be liable to remove, at the time of expiry or termination of the Lease back Agreement, any fixtures and fittings or to reverse alterations as made by the Lessee during the Lease Period . 
 
 The Lessor hereby represents and warrants that at the time of execution of this Leaseback Agreement , the Demised Premises is free from any lien, charge, encumbrance, etc. of whatsoever nature, and that the Demised Premises shall remain unencumbered throughout the Lease Period , and any subsequent renewed Lease Period , of this Lease back Agreement. 
 
 The Lessor shall not cause the Demised Premise s to become subject to any lien, charge or encumbrance whatsoever. 
 
 The Lessor hereby undertake s that Lessee shall enjoy quiet and peaceful possession of the Demised Premises from the date of signing of this Leaseback Agreement and during the Lease Period, without any hindrance or disturbance . 
 
 The Lessor shall not hinder in any way the Lessee’s right to manage the Demised Premises as it deems fit, including determining the schedule of rates and charges for the luxury hotel, managing occupancy, day to day operations, human resource and other aspects associated with the Permitted Use. 
 
 LESSEE’S COVENANTS 
 
 The Lessee shall regularly and promptly pay the agreed Rent on monthly basis, along with Complimentary Vouchers, in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 The Lessee shall , at its own cost, repair and maintain the Demised Premises, including all fixtures and fittings therein, and shall ensure that the Demised Premises free of any defects and maintained in a good tenantable con dition, during the Lease Period, subject to the provisions of the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 The Lessee shall regularly and promptly pay all utility bills and other related charges during the Lease Period . 
 
 WARRANTIES 
 The Lessor confirms having read, understood and agrees to comply with the provisions of this Leaseback Agreement and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Lessee. 
 
 The Lessor confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Lessor herein are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Lessor confirms and warrants that the Lessor (and where there is more than one Lessor , each such Lessor ) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Leaseback Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 The Lessor represents that it has good, valid, legal and subsisting title to the Demised Premises and is fully authorized to leaseback the Demised Premises. 
 
 EVENTS OF DEFAULT 
 
 I n the event that the Lessee fails to pay Rent for a period of six (6 ) months consecutively, then the Less ee shall do or cause to be done all acts necessary for the rights of the Lessor in the Demised Premises to be recorded in the relevant land registry. 
 
 In the event of breach of its obligations hereunder by the Lessor , the Lessee shall be at liberty for recourse and r edressal in the terms of the Leaseback Agreement against the Lessor (as the Lessee may determine in its sole discretion). 
 
 RENEWAL AND TERMINATION 
 
 Upon lapse of the Lease Period , the Leaseback Agreement may be renewed for a further period of ten (10) years upon written mutual consent of the Parties and on the same terms and conditions as the Leaseback Agreement . 
 
 T his Lease back Agreement may be terminated upon written mutual consent of both Parties . 
 
 In the event of termination of this Leaseback Agreement, the Lessee shall hand over peaceful and vacant possession of the Demised Premises to the Lessor. 
 
 FORCE MAJEURE 
 
 “Event of Force Majeure” means an act of God including but not limited to fire, flood, earthquake, windstorm or other natural disaster; act of any sovereign authority including but not limited to war, invasion, act of foreign enemies, hostilities (whether war be declared or not), civil war, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power or confiscation, nationalization, requisition, act of terrorism or destruction or damage to property by or under the order of any government or public or local authority or other Competent Authority or imposition of government sanction embargo or similar action; labour dispute including but not limited to strike, lockout or boycott; interruption or failure of utility service including but not limited to electric power, water or telephone service; failure of the transportation of any personnel, equipment, or any other matter or cause beyond the control of t he Lessor and Lessee that prevents them from completing or performing their obligations under this Lease back Agreement. The Lessee shall not be liable for such non-performance of payment of Rent under this Leaseback Agreement for so long as such Event of Force Majeure exists and its effects continue. 
 
 Should an Event of Force Majeure occur that is likely to or will delay the Commencement Date, the Lessee shall promptly notify the Lessor of the event and give the Lessor a revised Commencement Date or an estimate of the duration of the delay, followed by a revised Commencement Date as and when it can be determined. 
 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 
 The Agreement, as defined in Clause 1 of the Leaseback Agreement, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and there are no other representations, warranties, conditions or collateral agreements, express or implied, written or oral, whether made by the Lesse e , any agent, employee or representative of the Lessee or any other person including, without limitation, arising out of any marketing material including sales brochures, models, representative view sets, show room displays, photographs, videos, illustrations, renderings, revenue projections or pro-forma statements provided to the Lessor or made available for his/her viewing and, upon acceptance by the Lessee , the Leaseback Agreement shall form a binding agreement subject to the terms and conditions contained herein. 
 
 Except as contemplated in the Leaseback Agreement, any modification or amendment to the Leaseback Agreement shall be in writing and expressly stating the intention to modify, amend or waive any provision of the Agreement, duly signed by both Parties. 
 GOVERNING LAW AND ARBITRATION 
 The Leaseback Agreement and the rights and obligations of the Parties under or pursuant to the Leaseback Agreement shall be governed and construed according to the laws of Pakistan, with the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Lahore. 
 
 Any dispute between the Parties arising out of or with respect to the Leaseback Agreement will be resolved amicably between the Parties within fifteen (15) days of its so arising, failing which it shall be referred to and settled by arbitration under the Arbitration Act (X of 1940). After lapse of fifteen (15) days, arbitration proceedings may be initiated by delivery of a notice in writing by either Party to the other Party. The arbitration panel shall consist of three arbitrators: one each to be appointed by each Party and the third to be appointed mutually by the first two arbitrators. The place of arbitration shall be Lahore and the language of the arbitration proceedings shall be English. The decision and award of the arbitrator(s), as the case may be, shall be final, non-appealable and binding on both Parties, including decisions as to costs. 
 NOTICES 
 Without prejudice to the right to serve notice by any other means, any notice required to be served under the Leaseback Agreement shall be in writing in the English language and shall be deemed sufficiently served forty-eight (48) hours after it has been mailed by registered post or twenty-four (24) hours if served through e-mail to the address of the Party to be served that is set out in the Leaseback Agreement or to such other address of which a notice has been previously given by the Party. 
 
 It is clarified that in the case there is more than one Lessor , notice to any one Lessor shall be deemed as notice to all Lessors and the Lessee shall be under no obligation to write to each Lessor individually. 
 
 Lessor shall notify the Lessee in writing, in advance, of any change of address (postal, email, or otherwise). Lessor’s failure to report a change of address shall not affect validity of service of any notice that may be served by the Lessee to the Lessor at the last known address. 
 S URVIVAL 
 The Leaseback Agreement shall en ure to the benefit of and be binding upon the Parties hereto and their respective personal representatives, heirs, successors, and permitted assignees. 
 
 The Lessee agrees that in case of the death of the Lessor, the Lessee shall make reasonable efforts to assist the N ominee of the to procure the succession of the legal heirs to the rights of the Lessor under the Leaseback Agreement, in accordance with the requirements of applicable laws of inheritance. Provided that such N ominee shall cause all such legal heirs to execute a letter of adherence (or such other document which confirms the legal heirs taking over and being fully bound by the obligations of the Lessor under the Leaseback Agreement) and indemnifies the Lessee for any loss or damage on account of claims by the other legal heirs of the Lessor . 
 COUNTERPARTS 
 The Leaseback Agreement may be executed, accepted and delivered in two counterparts, both of which shall together constitute one and the same Agreement. 
 WAIVER 
 The delay or failure of either Party to enforce or insist upon strict compliance with any of the terms or conditions of the Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of said Party’s rights hereunder. 
 SEVERABILITY 
 If any one or more provisions of the Leaseback Agreement or any part thereof are declared or adjudged to be illegal or invalid or unenforceable under any applicable law, such illegality, invalidity or unenforceability shall not invalidate the other provisions herein, which shall remain in full force and effect, and the Parties shall, within thirty (30) days of such declaration or judgment, substitute the affected provisions in such a way that, to the maximum extent possible, the substitution carries out the original intent of the Parties as to the point or points in question . 
 GOOD FAITH 
 Each Party shall in good faith perform their obligations under the Leaseback Agreement based on confidence placed by such Party in the other and thereon relied upon by such Party. 
 
 ACKNOWLEDGEMENT 
 The Lessor hereby confirms having read and understood the Leaseback Agreement in its entirety, and is affixing his/her signature in the presence of witnesses.
